name: Remtravel's Excavation
summary: Prospector Remtravel's dig in southern Darkshore has broken into ancient ruins.

sections.title: A Quarry Overrun
sections.body: Prospector Remtravel came to southern Darkshore in search of relics from the distant past. He set up a large dig, far from Auberdine's safety. As his team cut through old layers of earth, they uncovered Gravelflint troggs and hulking stone golems. The creatures overran the quarry and scattered the miners. Now Remtravel scrambles to recover his most promising finds.

sections.title: The Missing Fossil
sections.body: Before chaos swept the excavation, the miners uncovered a rare fossil with curious mystic properties. In the panic of the trogg attack, the absent-minded prospector misplaced it among the sprawling dirt pits. Recovering the relic means venturing back into the dig. Vicious troggs and ancient automatons awakened by the pickaxes remain there.

faq.answer: Prospector Remtravel established this archaeological dig in southern Darkshore while searching for ancient fossils and subterranean relics.
Dwarven miners dug too deeply and broke into underground caverns. Their work awakened the Gravelflint troggs and dormant stone golems.
Prospector Remtravel is a dwarven archaeologist leading the excavation. He has a keen eye for artifacts, but lost track of a key fossil when the dig came under attack.

faq.q: What kind of relic was discovered here?
faq.answer: Shortly before the troggs surged from below, Remtravel uncovered an unusual fossil with strange mystic properties.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know the Explorers' League seeks the secrets of the past. Digging in foreign lands can uncover dangerous troggs along with them.
As a night elf, you may view Alliance dwarves' deep digging with skepticism, especially when it awakens wild troggs on Darkshore's ancient soil.
